_help: Act 2, the military club: hiring Tom Hargreaves (hired_hargreaves), 600, or 300 now and 300 owed (owe_hargreaves). An old comrade's hello, then a transaction; his question about the wounded is on his rapport ladder now. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

already.speaker: hargreaves
already.line: Rifles cleaned, boots polished. Say the word.

first.speaker: hargreaves
first.line: Well, I'll be. Heard you'd gone private. If it's a man who keeps people alive you want, I'm six hundred pounds.

choices.label: Hire him
choices.line: Six hundred pounds. Worth every penny.

choices.label: Half now, half later
choices.line: Three hundred now, three hundred when we're home.

joined.speaker: hargreaves
joined.line: Then I'm your man. I'll want to see every rifle before we leave.

joined_owed.speaker: hargreaves
joined_owed.line: Your word's good with me. Don't make me regret it.

too_rich.speaker: hargreaves
too_rich.line: Door's always open. Bar's always open, come to that.
